hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: To produce the lexicographically smallest result, prioritize transforming earlier characters to letter a.

hints.title: Cyclic Cost
hints.text: The minimum cyclic distance from any character to letter a is min(diff, 26 - diff) where diff = ord(c) - ord('a').

hints.title: Budget Allocation
hints.text: If budget k can cover the distance to letter a, replace with letter a and deduct. Otherwise, shift the character backwards by k and exhaust budget.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive search over character modifications produces exponential state branching.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Greedily optimize the most significant characters first using cyclic distance.
